parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AK/SK pair or STS temporary authorization.

parameters.name: aliyunPk
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the group member.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: The primary key ID of the code group.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The enterprise identifier, also known as the enterprise ID, in string format. You can obtain it from the China Yunxiao access URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId].
